estimand_rationale: The program record supplies an activity name ('player props') and an ordering constraint ('last, and not before the market premise is evidenced') and nothing else. No target statistic, unit or denominator is stated anywhere. The live market prices four distinct box-score categories (points, rebounds, assists, threes), so a single estimand is at minimum four undecided candidate estimands. No player-level target artifact for any of the four exists in this lane; the only registered player-level target family targets turnovers, a different quantity.

data_blockers.statement: No estimand anywhere in the documentation; only a deferred activity name and an ordering constraint.
Explicitly gated behind the same open market-premise decision (P2B_MARKET_ODDS_ELIGIBILITY, RUNNING) that also gates F14. Not this node's decision.
K0_MATCHED schema target field is const-pinned to REGULATION_EQUIVALENT_TEAM_OFFENSIVE_POSSESSIONS; no player-props K0 record can presently exist.
Neither props file carries player_id; linkage is a normalized-name join measured at 97.85%, with an undocumented residual-resolution procedure.
Three of the four priced markets (rebounds, assists, threes) have zero historical coverage; only player_points has retrospective rows.
Zero props coverage for 2021-2023 (1,416 of 2,990 universe team-game rows, 47.4%).
Retrospective archive captures exactly one snapshot per game; no decision-time label diversity exists to build a decision-time pairing from.
The only registered player-level target family (player_turnover_targets_v1) targets turnovers, not points/rebounds/assists/threes, and is not a reusable starting point.
15.97% of master_player rows have a null pts tied to dnp_reason; no document states how a props target would treat these rows.
C11_REBOUND_CHANNEL records rebound_type unresolved on all 125,309 rebound rows in both sources; a rebounds-market estimand inherits this open dependency.
48 of 79 live priced player-games postdate master_player's coverage horizon; the live stream is not currently gradeable and no refresh-cadence guarantee is documented.

does_not_authorise_fitting_statement: This draft does NOT authorise fitting. Fitting requires a target contract (absent), a matched K0 (the schema that would hold one is pinned to a different target and no record exists for any player-props arm), cutoff-valid evidence (real per-row evidence exists for exactly one of four priced markets, for three of six universe seasons, at one snapshot per game, joined by name rather than by key), a preregistration (none drafted) and an independent gate review (not this node's). None of the five is in this node's gift.
why_last_by_design: E1 places player props last in the same sentence that conditions it on the unresolved market premise; the K0 machinery it would need was built and hardened on the settled team target; the measured evidence base is the thinnest audited in this wave (one of four markets, starting 2024 not 2021, one snapshot per game, no identity key); what would move this track is the P2B decision, a player-grain K0 extension owned elsewhere, and a props-specific target contract -- none of which this node has the mandate or write scope to produce.

stop_conditions_restated_open.statement: The market-odds family was excluded on a capture-window ground P29 found contradicted by an archive that predates it. This is the same market premise E1 makes a precondition for player props. Not resolved here; adjudication belongs to P2B_MARKET_ODDS_ELIGIBILITY.
